Episode 246. The Battle for the Mitra Desert (21)
"So, you didn't pursue them because annihilation was impossible, is that what you're saying?"

“That's right, Kelliark Zipple. Above all, the biggest reason was the unpredictable threat lurking beyond the dimensional gate. If we recklessly pursued the Vamel alliance and the Plutonian suddenly appeared, everyone except me could be wiped out.”
Tower of Tales.
Kelliark locked eyes with Elona.

In this desert battle, Elona did not attack the Vamel alliance until they safely retreated. Instead, as soon as the alliance disappeared, she joined the Red Plutonian and spread her magic beyond the dimensional rift.
“That makes sense. It was a logical choice.”
“May I leave now?”
“Yes.”
As Elona left, Kelliark shrugged.
“It's clear. The Holy Crown is rapidly losing its control. Losing Drakka is less painful than this.”
“Huh, then what do we do? Kelliark, my friend. Won’t Elona try to kill us first when she comes back to her senses?”
“Just because she's not fully controlled doesn't mean she has complete free will. For Elona Zipple, it might be much better to be bound to the Holy Crown.”
“In what way?”
“In the sense that she doesn’t have to confront her corrupted self. Also, her forgotten past... You just keep focusing on injecting the poison.”
“Understood, my friend Kelliark.”
Lafrarosa.
“Whew...”
Vahn caught her breath and looked around.

Parts of the Temple of the Battle God had collapsed, covering the area in debris. The city, where the hearts of the dead brothers were laid, had turned into ruins, and most of the ordinary warriors could barely stand.
Now, 10 minutes had passed since the bombardment stopped.
‘Perhaps the attack will start again within 30 minutes. It has been this way so far...’
Since the rift opened in the Great Desert and the full-scale war began, Lafrarosa had been enduring an average of more than 17 hours of shelling by the Red Plutonian per day.
Moreover, with Elona Zipple’s magic being added for several hours as just seen, and with the increasing pressure from dimension errors, everyone was bound to become exhausted.
It was even more so since four of the Battle Kings were missing.
“From today on, even if the rift opens, I won’t send the Warrior King brothers outside.”
Upon Vahn’s statement, the 5th Battle King Boras nodded.

“You've thought well, Battle God brother. If more Battle King brothers are lost here, there's no solution. The offense from the enemies beyond the dimension is also becoming stronger and more persistent.”
It was true.
As powerful as the Plutonian might be, they couldn’t keep up in such adverse conditions.
“However, I'm worried about the outside, Brother Boras. Brother Jin would surely know that the enemies are targeting us, yet there’s no sign of it stopping.”

“I believe it's not because Brother Jin is being pushed back, but because he has some plan. Moreover, with the addition of brothers like Belize, Linpa, Garmund, and Teto, whatever Brother Jin's plan might be, he should be able to act more smoothly.”
Boras pulled out a bottle of gem wine from his bosom and offered it to Vahn. As Vahn brought the wine to her lips, the Lingling sitting on his shoulder sniffed the scent and turned away instantly.
[Ugh, what’s so tasty about this stuff? Sometimes I just can’t understand Vahn and the Plutonian.]
“You need a radiant heart to truly appreciate the taste of gem wine.”
[Even if I had a radiant heart, I wouldn't drink this.]
“Hehehe, Lingling, little ones like you shouldn't drink alcohol, even without a radiant heart. By the way, are there still no signs of Jin's consciousness connecting?"
At Boras’s question, Lingling shook its head.

[I find it strange too. Other members of the Plutonian can communicate with others to some extent, but I can't hear that fool’s voice at all. Instead, I feel the will of something else being conveyed.]
“Some other will?”
[Yes, maybe I should describe it as a very dark will? It's hard to explain.]

“That might be the will of the witch, Lingling. The spatial error currently occurring in Lafrarosa is likely related to her. And since you could be considered a being born from the power of the first chaos, which means from the witch's power, it's highly probable you’re influenced by it.”
Vahn answered for Boras. Lingling seemed displeased by the idea that it was related to the witch, wrinkling its nose.

[Hmph, my home is here in Lafrarosa, and my family consists of Vahn, the Plutonian, and that foolish guy. Well... if that annoying one, whether she's a witch or whatever, feels even a little sorry for me, it would be nice if she just opened the dimensional gate wide.]
“Hehe, why would the witch feel sorry for you, Lingling?”
[Boras, she made me come into existence, so she can be considered some sort of creator, right? She has to take responsibility. If I ever meet that witch, I would ask her to grant me one wish.]
"Ho-ho, even a wish?"
[Yes! Vahn's condition has deteriorated a bit because of me, so I'll ask her to fix that. They say the witch has more power than the gods.]
Vahn and Bolas imagined for a moment Lingling asking Heluram for a wish.
"…Lingling. The witch might grant your wish. However, it might not be in the way you expect."
"You're right, God Brother. If you make such a wish... she might erase you from existence? Then Sister Vahn can conserve the energy she uses to keep you comfortable."
[Eek, what's that about!]
"But there's no reason for you to make a wish to the witch, so don’t worry. Even if she ever tries to harm you, I'll stop her."
[Hehe, really? So, are you stronger than the witch, Vahn?]
"Um... that's a difficult question to answer."
[Why?]

"For instance, if someone asks who the strongest person in the world is, I could confidently say it's me. But if they ask if I'm stronger than the sea, sun, or wind, that’s harder to answer. It's like that."
[Aha... but I can't imagine you being defeated by anyone.]
"Hahaha, neither can we, Lingling."
"But for a moment..."
Vahn seemed to remember something and continued speaking.
"If the witch and I were to fight, I feel that for just one moment, I would have an absolute advantage. If I can defeat the witch in that moment, it's my victory. If not, it's my defeat."
[So, you mean for that one moment, you can be stronger than even the sun or the sea?]
"Yes, I could even cut them with a single stroke."
Although Vahn said this as a joke, both Lingling and Boras seemed somewhat convinced and nodded in agreement.
"Alright, I've teased enough for now. It's time to prepare the medicine for our brothers."
"Thanks for your hard work, Brother Boras."
Just as Boras was about to leave, they suddenly noticed Tantel running towards them from a distance.
"God Brother!"
"Brother Tantel? What's going on?"
Tantel was among the average warriors who had received less damage. Until now, he had been collecting the radiant hearts of the deceased brothers hung on every house door in the ruined city.
While doing that, he found a peculiar fragment and quickly came to report it to Vahn.
"Take a look at this, God Brother. Fortunately, Brother Boras is here too."
"This is…"
"Isn't this an ancient millennium iron?"
Ancient millennium iron.
That mineral is quite abundant in Lafrarosa, but there was no such form. All of it was crafted into weapons and stored in the armory.
The ancient iron that Tantel brought looked like a crumpled rock that was torn from something. It was clearly something that couldn't be found in an empty city on a regular day.
[Uh... Vahn! I can feel a very faint aura of that bastard from this item?]

Lingling sensed the aura used in the ancient iron protection box of the liberation device. It was such a faint aura that even Vahn couldn’t sense it. Lingling could sense it since it had once been one with Jin.
The eyes of the Plutonian members widened. Vahn, her face flushed, alternately looked at Lingling and the fragment of the ancient iron.
"Jin brother must have tried to send us something for our sake...!"
"Oh?"
"Um, if we think negatively, it could be a torn piece of armor. But considering the purity of the millennium iron, it's likely to be a box for shock protection, God brother."
"Tantel, how many of the regular soldiers can move quickly right now?"
"About seven."

"Then leave two to assist Boras brother in his treatment, and take the rest to search the area where the fragment was found. Take Kaiyo brother with you in case of an attack during the search, but return to the main hall without delay if the attack starts."
"Yes, God Brother!"

"God Brother, I will analyze this iron after preparing the medicine. If my guess is correct, the item inside this iron is more important. Probably used an iron box to protect against dimensional errors and the impact of bombardments!"
Tantel and Boras left the scene.
First, Vahn comforted Lingling. If Lingling hadn't immediately recognized the aura, the Plutonian wouldn’t have realized that the iron fragment was something sent by Jin.
[Hehe, I did well, right, Vahn?]
"You did very well, Lingling. Now I need to review the recent attacks, so you should go help Brother Boras."
[Okay!]

Soon, Vahn sat down and began to review the moment when he defended against the attacks. She was trying to see if something like the ancient iron had ever gotten caught in the protective barrier that she spread across the entire Battle God main hall.
It wasn’t long before Vahn could confirm her answer.

‘The ancient iron never got stuck in my protective barrier. It was all the red auras and magic powers of the Red Plutonian. That means this item was summoned directly into Lafrarosa as it crossed dimensions.’

However, the likelihood of it being summoned inside Lafrarosa every time was low. Roughly, only about 10% of the Red Plutonian’s attacks directly targeted the inside, bypassing the protective barrier.

‘The intense heat and shock waves emitted by the red aura and magic power could easily destroy an item wrapped in iron. Since the items Jin sends pass through with those auras, from now on, I need to control the protective barrier more precisely. If anything other than the red aura and magic power is detected, I should be able to take action immediately.’
